decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through-glass vias are a core advanced packaging offering that fits the firm's strategy toward multifunctional packaging wafers.
Carrier wafers for thin and small-wafer handling match the stated direction of reusable carriers and need little extra resource to keep offering.
The Cu-interposer technology launched at SEMICON Europa supports growing advanced packaging demand and builds on existing via and structuring know-how.
The Wafer Universe off-the-shelf brand is a low-cost sales channel for standard glass and quartz wafers, though it competes with low-cost suppliers.
Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the core and riskier, but they relate to the firm's glass structuring and metallization competences and may still be developed further.
